d: As the Key Account Specialist for the Sultanate of Oman (Territory), based in Muscat, you will contribute to our corporate values by developing and maintaining strong relationships with key customers and healthcare professionals, ensuring effective promotion and commercialization of Emmaus products within the assigned territory.

You will be responsible for managing assigned key accounts, identifying business opportunities, implementing the company's commercial strategy, and achieving established sales objectives. Furthermore, you will work closely with healthcare professionals, hospital stakeholders, pharmacies, and other relevant decision-makers to strengthen product awareness, support market access, and contribute to sustainable business growth.
You will play an important role in Emmaus Medical's continued development and commercial presence in Oman, contributing to our regional objectives in the Middle East and Africa.
q: Pharmaceutical industry background with at least three years of experience in pharmaceutical sales, preferably within multinational pharmaceutical companies (MNCs).
Previous experience in key account management or hospital/specialty pharmaceutical sales is strongly preferred.
Experience in the Omani pharmaceutical market is a MUST.
Specialty Medicine, Hematology, Oncology and/or Rare Diseases experience is strongly preferred.
Proven ability to develop and maintain successful customer relationships and contribute to sales growth within hospital and pharmacy accounts.
Good understanding of the pharmaceutical market, healthcare systems, and key stakeholders in Oman.
Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Result-oriented, proactive, and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently.
Strong scientific knowledge and the ability to understand and communicate clinical and scientific data.
Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Fluency in English and Arabic is required.
B.S. or B.A. degree required, preferably in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related scientific field.
Previous experience in hospital or specialty pharmaceutical sales is preferred.
Experience in Hematology, Oncology, Specialty Medicine and/or Rare Diseases is an advantage.
Good knowledge of the Omani healthcare market and its institutional structures.
Administrative excellence is required, including call reporting, territory planning, budget management, expense reporting, and special projects.
Ability to travel within the Sultanate of Oman as required by the territory.
r: Act as a brand ambassador for Emmaus Middle East and Africa with key customers, healthcare professionals, and relevant stakeholders in the Territory.
Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with key accounts, including hospitals, pharmacies, healthcare institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
Achieve and exceed established sales objectives and contribute to consistent business growth within the assigned territory.
Implement the company's commercial and marketing strategies at the account level, ensuring effective product positioning and promotion.
Develop and execute account plans to maximize business opportunities and strengthen customer engagement.
Identify new business opportunities, potential customers, and opportunities for product expansion within existing accounts.
Promote Emmaus products to relevant healthcare professionals, ensuring accurate, effective, and compliant communication of product information.
Support efforts to achieve product listing, formulary inclusion, and incorporation into relevant hospital protocols and treatment guidelines.
Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), physicians, pharmacists, procurement teams, and other relevant decision-makers.
Ensure regular customer visits and effective territory coverage, maintaining appropriate call plans and customer engagement records.
Monitor sales performance, market developments, customer feedback, and competitor activities, providing relevant market intelligence to management.
Ensure comprehensive knowledge of disease areas, company products, clinical data, and competitive products within the relevant therapeutic areas.
Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Commercial Operations, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Pharmacovigilance, to support business objectives.
Support the implementation of marketing initiatives, medical activities, congresses, and other commercial projects within the Territory.
Monitor product availability and customer demand, coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders to support uninterrupted product supply.
Manage assigned territory resources and budgets responsibly, ensuring appropriate allocation and accurate expense reporting.
Ensure that all commercial activities are conducted in accordance with Emmaus Medical's Code of Business Conduct, applicable local regulations, and industry compliance requirements.

d: Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.

QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.

QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.

Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.

Ensures the achievement of set targets/ objectives, business growth and expansion for the Corporate Sales Unit.
Implements and evaluates best practice work methods in area of responsibility to achieve optimum level of performance efficiency.

Implements KPI’s and best practices for role
Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial & non-financial performance.
q: Bachelors Degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Mathematics, or Economics (Related field of study).
MBA, CFA, or a related professional certification is a plus.
12 years banking experience with at least 4 years or more Treasury Sales experience
r: To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn-around time.
Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
Maintains relationships with key Corporate clients to maximise their retention as profitable customers of the Bank.

Ensures compliance to the department’s policies and procedures for conducting sales calls and visits, preparing presentation on products internally and externally, maintaining the contact database and maintaining/ collating MIS pertaining to profitability/ revenue.

Develops new Corporate relationships, within the delegated authority, allocates responsibility for these within the Corporate team and subsequently act as focal point for guidance and assistance in resolution of any contentious issues arising in the course of managing Corporate relationships.

Liaise with the Group Treasury to identify potential customers and to cross sell treasury services in addition to providing requisite training to Corporate Banking staff on the treasury products and services that are provided by the Group.
Maintains the database for corporate treasury customers, ensuring its timely update after contact with potential and current QNB customers.

Networks with Corporate customers and marketing groups within and outside QNB in order to solicit customer feedback, gain market intelligence, benchmark selling techniques and enhance the Group’s profile in the market.
Is involved in the Corporate product development process, in coordination with Group Treasury
Monitors and enhances the Corporate product development process, provide timely update to the Country GM and Group Treasury on customer needs and new market opportunities.
Sets meetings and visits with Corporate customers to present/ conduct meetings and visits.

Ensures that Corporate treasury sales team members have a constructive personal working relationship through regular planned calling, visits, entertainment etc…. with the objective that the customer is responsive to our calls and considers the Group a strategic partner when in need of Corporate treasury products and services.
Stay abreast of market and product developments in the area and update colleagues.
Maintains a well motivated, well trained, focused team with a reputation for the highest standards of professionalism and ethical behaviour to ensure a good name in the market.
